ApiErrorBody.description: The error object every failure carries (docs/07 section 11).
ApiErrorBody.title: ApiErrorBody

BenchmarkJob.description:
A benchmark job (POST /api/v1/benchmarks, GET /benchmarks/jobs/{job_id}).

``run_id`` names the published run once the job completed; ``progress``
is None until the first world reaches its first instance; ``error`` is
the curated envelope of a failed job.
BenchmarkJob.title: BenchmarkJob

BenchmarkRunOut.description:
One published run in GET /api/v1/benchmarks, from its ``summary.json``:
``selection`` is the part of the bank it scored, ``worlds`` its seeds.
BenchmarkRunOut.title: BenchmarkRunOut

BenchmarkStart.description:
Request for POST /api/v1/benchmarks; the seeds, strata and kind are
checked against the harness's own before a job starts.
BenchmarkStart.title: BenchmarkStart

BenchmarkSummary.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/benchmarks/latest and /benchmarks/{run_id}.

``summary`` is the run's ``summary.json`` (schema 2), passed through
unchanged: the only benchmark source the API publishes. ``run_kind``
and ``label`` are copied out of it so a client can tell a smoke or
sweep run from an official result without reading the summary.
BenchmarkSummary.title: BenchmarkSummary

Check.description:
One readiness check: whether it passed and a curated detail, never a
service address or raw driver or provider text.
Check.title: Check

Citation.description: A citation rendered under an answer; every citation is inspectable.

record_table.description: Source table of a record block or graph node; None for documents
record_table.title: Record Table

Citation.title: Citation

ColumnOut.description: One column; ``description`` is None where the schema registry has none.
ColumnOut.title: ColumnOut

ConceptOut.description:
One ontology concept. ``labels`` and ``synonyms`` are keyed by
language, ``binding_counts`` by market id; codes shared by every market
(channels, incident types) count under ``shared``. ``relationships`` are
the relationship types the concept takes part in, derived from ingestion
(``IS_A`` with a parent or child, ``MAPS_TO`` with a bound code).
ConceptOut.title: ConceptOut

DatasetDetail.description:
Response for GET /datasets/{dataset_id}; ``index_status`` is None
when no persistent index was built over the world.
DatasetDetail.title: DatasetDetail

DatasetSummary.description:
One generated world as GET /datasets lists it; ``active`` marks the
world the lab serves (``DATASET_DIR``).
DatasetSummary.title: DatasetSummary

DemoQuestion.description:
A demo question: one instance of the presentation world's frozen bank.

Pipeline-visible fields only: the text every pipeline receives, never
the expected answer, checks or claims. ``market_scope`` is empty (all
markets): the bank defines no scope of its own.
DemoQuestion.title: DemoQuestion

EdgeSummary.description: How many relationships of one type meet a node in one direction.
EdgeSummary.title: EdgeSummary

Empty.description: Lifecycle events that carry no fields.
Empty.title: Empty

ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every non-2xx response: ``{"error": {...}}``.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

ErrorPayload.description:
``pipeline.failed``, ``pipeline.cancelled``, ``run.failed`` and
``run.cancelled`` carry the docs/07 section 11 error envelope.
ErrorPayload.title: ErrorPayload

EvidenceChunk.description: One retrieved chunk with its provenance and ranking outcome.

dense_rank.description: 1-based rank in the dense channel; None if absent or unknown
dense_rank.title: Dense Rank

discard_reason.description: Why the chunk was not selected: context_budget | slot_limit | duplicate | superseded_by_structured_fact
discard_reason.title: Discard Reason

discovered_via.description: How the chunk entered the candidate set: vector | graph_traversal | vector+graph_traversal
discovered_via.title: Discovered Via

kind.description: chunk (document text) | record (table row) | node (graph block)
kind.title: Kind

record_table.description: Source table when kind is record, or of a graph node's authoritative row
record_table.title: Record Table

rerank_score.description: Reranker score when reranking is enabled
rerank_score.title: Rerank Score

similarity.description: Score within the candidate's channel: for chunks and records the fused reciprocal-rank score of the dense and sparse channels (not a cosine); for graph nodes the graph composite score
similarity.title: Similarity

sparse_rank.description: 1-based rank in the sparse channel; None if absent or unknown
sparse_rank.title: Sparse Rank

EvidenceChunk.title: EvidenceChunk

GraphEntityResolved.description:
A resolver match carries ``confidence``; a vector fallback seed has no
resolver confidence and carries ``fused_score`` instead.
GraphEntityResolved.title: GraphEntityResolved

GraphEvidence.description:
One graph node candidate with its transparent ranking outcome.

Structured nodes additionally carry authoritative facts read from the
warehouse Parquet layer (the graph guides, Parquet states facts).

authoritative.description: Authoritative structured-layer facts for this node
authoritative.title: Authoritative

rerank_score.description: Shared reranker score; None when the node was never judged
rerank_score.title: Rerank Score

GraphEvidence.title: GraphEvidence

GraphRunResult.description: Complete record of one graph-enhanced execution (pipeline B or C).
GraphRunResult.title: GraphRunResult

GraphSchema.description:
Response for GET /graph/schema: the graph model and the traversal
settings pipelines B and C run with.
GraphSchema.title: GraphSchema

GraphStats.description:
Response for GET /graph/stats, read from the active dataset's
``_graph_stats.json``: what its ingestion pushed, not a live count.
GraphStats.title: GraphStats

IndexStatus.description: The vector index built over a world, from its index manifest.
IndexStatus.title: IndexStatus

JobProgress.description: The world a job is running and how far through its instances it is.
JobProgress.title: JobProgress

LivePipelineScore.description:
One pipeline's deterministic scores on a live bank question; None
where the instance does not define the metric.
LivePipelineScore.title: LivePipelineScore

LiveScore.description:
A completed bank question's live answers scored against its answer
key by the deterministic scorers (never the judge, spec 10a.1).
LiveScore.title: LiveScore

MemberOut.description:
A local code bound to a concept; ``name`` is its local display name
when the term table has one.
MemberOut.title: MemberOut

ModelOut.description:
One configured model. ``reachable`` is null for a model that runs in
process and has not been loaded.
ModelOut.title: ModelOut

ModelStarted.description:
Start of an embedding or generation stage (``rag.embedding.started``,
``rag.generation.started``, ``graph.generation.started``).
ModelStarted.title: ModelStarted

NeighbourOut.description: One relationship from the node and the node at its other end.
NeighbourOut.title: NeighbourOut

Neighbours.description:
Response for GET /graph/nodes/{node_id}/neighbours; ``truncated``
says the node has more neighbours than ``limit``.
Neighbours.title: Neighbours

NodeOut.description:
One graph node; ``provenance`` is None for a node no source table
maps to (PrizeType, BusinessConcept).
NodeOut.title: NodeOut

PipelineScore.description:
One pipeline's means over the scored repeats of one question; None
where no scored repeat defines the metric.
PipelineScore.title: PipelineScore

ProvenanceOut.description: The warehouse row a graph node was built from.
ProvenanceOut.title: ProvenanceOut

QueryAccepted.description: Response for POST /api/v1/queries: the run is queued for its worker.
QueryAccepted.title: QueryAccepted

QueryRequest.description:
Request for POST /api/v1/queries (docs/07 section 4).

Unknown fields are refused, so a client still sending the retired
``profile`` gets a 422 rather than a silently ignored field.
QueryRequest.title: QueryRequest

QueryResults.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/queries/{run_id}: the summary plus every
stored pipeline result, readable as soon as each pipeline finishes.

``answer_key`` says whether the question has one: "none" for an ad hoc
question, which is never scored. ``score_status`` says where the score
stands: "not_applicable" for an ad hoc question and for a run that was
cancelled or failed, "pending" for a completed bank question until its
score is written (just after the final status), then "scored" with
``score`` set, or "failed" when scoring failed.
QueryResults.title: QueryResults

QuestionOut.description:
One bank question for the Help screen (GET /api/v1/benchmarks/questions).

``hidden_truth`` is the planted scenario's truth for H5 questions, else
None. ``scores`` are per pipeline from the chosen run, None when that run
did not score this question or no run exists.
QuestionOut.title: QuestionOut

RagAnswer.description:
Generated answer plus its cost and grounded citations.

`citations` lists every block shown to the model in prompt order (the
selected evidence in judge order, whatever its kind), so
`cited_blocks[i]` refers to `citations[cited_blocks[i] - 1]`.

cited_blocks.description: 1-based context blocks the answer cites, in first-seen order
cited_blocks.title: Cited Blocks

text.description: Parsed prose answer; what the evaluator scores
text.title: Text

usage.description: Gateway token counts when the provider reports them
usage.title: Usage

verdict.description: One-line verdict; empty when the model gave none
verdict.title: Verdict

RagAnswer.title: RagAnswer

RagRunResult.description: Complete record of one standard RAG execution.
RagRunResult.title: RagRunResult

Readiness.description: Response for GET /api/v1/health/ready: 200 when ready, else 503.
Readiness.title: Readiness

RecordOut.description:
One warehouse row and the graph node it maps to.

``graph_node_id`` is the id ingestion gives the row's node
(``app.graph.node_rows.NODE_TABLES``); None with ``edges`` empty when the
table creates no nodes. For a world the graph does not hold, ``edges``
is None and ``graph_error`` is ``OTHER_WORLD``; when the graph cannot be
read, the node id is kept, ``edges`` is None and ``graph_error`` is
``GRAPH_QUERY_ERROR``.
RecordOut.title: RecordOut

RecordedEvent.description:
One execution event: the envelope shared by replay and the stream
(docs/07 section 6). ``pipeline`` is ``run`` for run lifecycle events.
RecordedEvent.title: RecordedEvent

RelTypeOut.description: One relationship type between the labels it joins.
RelTypeOut.title: RelTypeOut

RowPage.description:
One page of sample rows, ordered by the primary key; ``total`` counts
every row matching the same filter.
RowPage.title: RowPage

RunHistory.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/queries: newest first; ``next_before`` is the
``before`` value of the next page, or None on the last page.
RunHistory.title: RunHistory

RunSummary.description: One run as history lists it, and the response of POST .../cancel.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

ScenarioOut.description:
A catalogue scenario and whether the active dataset planted it. Carries
configuration only: never the truth ledger.
ScenarioOut.title: ScenarioOut

TableProvenance.description: Where a table's rows come from, as the world's manifest records it.
TableProvenance.title: TableProvenance

TableSchemaOut.description: One table of the data dictionary (GET /datasets/{dataset_id}/dictionary).
TableSchemaOut.title: TableSchemaOut

schema.title: Response List Benchmarks Api V1 Benchmarks Get

post.description:
Request the job to stop before its next instance; the instance in
progress finishes first, so the job stays running until then.

schema.title: Response Read Questions Api V1 Benchmarks Questions Get
Response List Datasets Api V1 Datasets Get
Response Read Dictionary Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Dictionary Get

get.description: One bank instance per demo stratum; a 503 before the bank is grounded.

schema.title: Response Read Demo Questions Api V1 Demo Questions Get

get.description: Liveness probe used by CI, Docker and the frontend.
Readiness: the lab, the index, Neo4j and the model provider.

schema.title: Response Read Members Api V1 Ontology Concepts  Concept Id  Members Get

get.description:
The run's events as server-sent events: every stored event after
the resume point, then each new one, closing after the terminal event.

schema.title: Response Read Scenarios Api V1 Scenarios Get
